transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’m having trouble keeping my answers straight. Like at work, someone will ask me something simple, like when a ring repair will be ready, and I’ll start talking about the invoice, then somehow garden soil, then mortgage papers. I can see people losing track of what I’m saying, and honestly, I’m losing it too.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric lately?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t felt unusually happy or “up” like that lately.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can’t hear?

Yes… sometimes. When the shop is really quiet, I’ll hear what sounds like a woman muttering my name from the polishing room. I’ll go check, because it feels real, but there’s nobody there. And sometimes I smell burning metal when the torches are off.
Have you had any seizures?
No, I don’t think I’ve had any seizures. At least, not that I know of.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or neurological condition?
No, not that I know of. I’ve never been told I have a brain or neurological condition.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day lately?
Yes… most mornings, lately. I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness, like everything in the house has lost its color before I even get to the shop. It’s there a lot of the day.
Have you heard the woman muttering your name at times when you were not feeling depressed?

Yes… there was a period before the depression really took hold when I was still doing my classes and gardening, and for several weeks I’d hear noises coming from the polishing room. I also kept worrying that customers were watching the business.
For at least one month, have you been hearing the woman muttering your name or feeling that customers were watching the business?
Yes. It’s been much longer than a month. The voices and that feeling that customers were watching the business started about a year and eight months ago.
Have you ever had a period when you felt abnormally energetic or needed much less sleep than usual?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a time where I was unusually energetic or barely needed sleep, no.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually grand or important, like you had special powers or abilities?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve never felt like I had special powers or was more important than other people.
Have you ever had a time when you were much more talkative than usual?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed myself being much more talkative than usual.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports persistent psychotic symptoms for about 1 year and 8 months, including auditory hallucinations, an olfactory hallucination, persecutory ideas that customers were watching the business, and marked derailment/disorganized speech. Psychotic symptoms were present for weeks before the depressive episode and have lasted well beyond 1 month, arguing against a mood disorder with psychotic features. There is no evidence of mania, known neurological illness, or seizures. This presentation is most consistent with paranoid schizophrenia.
